description: This Java test class 'S3StorageServiceIT' contains integration tests for the 'S3StorageService' in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing Amazon S3 storage functionality using a mock container and Spring dependencies.

classes.name: S3StorageServiceIT
classes.description: Integration test class for S3StorageService, setting up a mock S3 environment and testing storage functionalities.

methods.name: setupS3Client
methods.description: Initializes the S3AsyncClient with mock credentials, region, and endpoint before all tests run.

methods.name: newStorageService
methods.description: Overrides parent method to provide a new instance of S3StorageService configured with the mock client.
